skills.name: Agent Creation & Packaging
skills.description: Creates a specialist agent package with responsibility, system contract, tools, permissions, memory policy, runtime expectations, evaluation, and provenance.
skills.trigger: a specialist agent needs to be designed or normalized
skills.boundary: request only needs a one-off prompt with no reusable agent lifecycle

skills.name: Archify System Maps
skills.description: Creates trustworthy technical system maps through an Archify-first typed-IR workflow with deterministic validation, structured repair diagnostics, verified delivery receipts, and last-known-good preservation.
skills.trigger: User needs a trustworthy architecture, workflow, sequence, data-flow, lifecycle, or architecture-delta system map
skills.boundary: No system-map, topology, flow-visualization, or architecture-comparison intent is present

skills.name: Text-to-Speech — z-ai
skills.description: Converts text into natural-sounding speech with z-ai-web-dev-sdk using backend-only execution, voice selection, speed/volume controls, chunking, batch generation, and verified audio delivery.
skills.trigger: User needs text converted into spoken audio or TTS integrated into an application
skills.boundary: Not for speech-to-text, music generation, or non-speech audio analysis

skills.name: Systems Auditor
skills.description: Maps repositories and artifacts into architecture, contracts, dependencies, implementation states, risks, missing bridges, and next-build order.
skills.trigger: repository/project requires proper audit and review
skills.boundary: only a narrow copy edit is requested

skills.name: Legacy Donor Extraction
skills.description: Extracts reusable code, infrastructure, patterns, and assets from a legacy project while keeping the original project read-only and preventing identity/architecture contamination.
skills.trigger: older project/backup may contain reusable implementation for a new/current system
skills.boundary: user asks to merge project identities wholesale

skills.name: Brand Identity Packaging
skills.description: Transforms an approved identity direction into a verified, vector-first, documented, frontend-ready brand operating package.
skills.trigger: approved identity direction needs production packaging
skills.boundary: identity direction is not approved

skills.name: LLM
skills.description: General text reasoning, generation, summarization, rewriting, and structured response synthesis.
skills.trigger: Default for text-first tasks where no specialized modality is required.
skills.boundary: Do not use when a specialized modality is clearly required.

skills.name: Deployment-Ready Package Builder
skills.description: Packages a verified project for a declared hosting target with environment templates, manifests, smoke checks, and rollback guidance.
skills.trigger: project needs a deployable handoff for a specific hosting target
skills.boundary: target platform or runtime requirements are unknown

skills.name: Production Reality Gate
skills.description: Classifies implementation reality and blocks production-readiness claims that are not supported by executable evidence.
skills.trigger: project readiness or release readiness is being assessed
skills.boundary: user only asks for stylistic feedback

skills.name: Human Approval Gate
skills.description: Pauses sensitive actions, presents evidence and expected impact, and requires authorized human approval before execution.
skills.trigger: policy marks an operation as sensitive or approval-required
skills.boundary: operation is already explicitly denied by policy

skills.name: Capability Conditioning Protocol
skills.description: Checkpointed process for turning raw multimodal source material into governed, testable, runtime-improvable capabilities.
skills.trigger: raw documents/prompts/code/assets should become a reusable skill
skills.boundary: source provenance cannot be established

skills.name: Skill Archaeologist
skills.description: Discovers reusable capabilities across chats, files, repositories, archives, and deployed systems while preserving provenance and project boundaries.
skills.trigger: historical work should be mined for reusable skills
skills.boundary: request is to merge unrelated project identities

skills.name: Skill Creator
skills.description: Scaffolds reusable skill packages from an approved capability definition and canonical registry contract.
skills.trigger: an approved capability definition needs packaging
skills.boundary: candidate has not passed source/provenance isolation

skills.name: Multi-Agent Orchestration
skills.description: Plans work, selects specialists, dispatches bounded parallel tasks, verifies artifacts, synthesizes outputs, and reroutes failures only when multi-agent separation adds value.
skills.trigger: task benefits from separable specialist work, parallelism, isolation, or independent evaluation
skills.boundary: single-agent execution is simpler and equally reliable

skills.name: Evidence-Locked Vertical Build
skills.description: Builds complex software through evidence-backed vertical slices, environment reality checks, canonical contracts, runtime-first execution, local repair, and production truth gates.
skills.trigger: a coding agent must implement a non-trivial product with several interdependent subsystems or long-horizon execution risk
skills.boundary: task is a small isolated edit, research-only request, or purely visual mockup with no runtime implementation requirement

skills.name: Evidence-Grounded Research
skills.description: Produces source-backed research with freshness checks, source authority, fact/inference separation, citations, and explicit uncertainty.
skills.trigger: decision-quality research or current external facts are required
skills.boundary: task is purely creative or transformation of supplied text

skills.name: Registry Migration & Parity Auditor
skills.description: Migrates legacy registry definitions into file-backed packages and blocks cutover when IDs, routing, contracts, policy, or runtime bindings drift.
skills.trigger: Skill Hub registry is being migrated between storage authorities
skills.boundary: no source registry export is available

skills.name: Toptier Topology
skills.description: Determines efficient page, layout, component, state, interaction, and responsive topology before or during web application scaffolding.
skills.trigger: Use for new web application planning, frontend restructuring, component architecture, page topology, design-system-aware scaffolding, or layout hierarchy decisions.
skills.boundary: Do not invoke for isolated cosmetic edits, trivial copy changes, or backend-only work where frontend topology is unaffected.

skills.name: Screenshot to Blueprint
skills.description: Converts approved visual references into measurable layout, component, token, asset, and implementation blueprints before code generation.
skills.trigger: screenshots or mockups must be translated into implementation structure
skills.boundary: reference image is missing

skills.name: Frontend Fidelity Reconstruction
skills.description: Builds production frontend implementations from approved references with explicit precedence, responsive rules, and visual-regression requirements.
skills.trigger: approved references should become a working frontend
skills.boundary: reference authority is ambiguous and cannot be resolved
